articles.title: Bitcoin eases to $77,900 as Binance customers pull $3.6 billion after withdrawals reopen
articles.description: Bitcoin fell 0.4% to around $77,900 since midnight UTC as Binance customers pulled a net $3.64 billion after withdrawals reopened and ETFs lost $643 million.

articles.title: Metals.io issues tokens backed by 25 tonnes of physical copper stored in Germany
articles.description: The company is starting with $366,000 worth of copper stored in Germany, hoping to build a market for investors to own and trade physical metal onchain.

articles.title: Binance hack fallout, U.S. midterms and jobs report: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 2.

articles.title: Live updates: Binance records $6 billion outflows after starting withdrawals, less then 4% of total holdings
articles.description: The outflows followed a 45-hour withdrawal freeze after a $6.3 billion theft, with rival exchanges attracting deposits as customers regained access to their funds.

articles.title: China’s Communist Party calls for a crackdown on corruption that uses crypto and blockchain
articles.description: China's Communist Party has named virtual currency and blockchain in a new anti-corruption call.

articles.title: Why stealing billions from a crypto exchange can be harder to stop than a bank theft
articles.description: The $6.3 billion Binance breach has revived a debate over whether crypto exchanges are less secure than banks or simply harder to protect once hackers get inside.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs lost $643 million in outflows Friday, and 2026 is barely green now
articles.description: The first trading day after the Binance hack saw the biggest ETF outflow since June 25.

articles.title: Strangers are begging the Binance hacker for bitcoin, one ‘help me bro’ at a time
articles.description: The 19 wallets holding 18,270 stolen BTC have taken in nothing since Thursday except payments worth under a dollar, each carrying a message, from pleas to laundering pitches to a token shill.

articles.title: Bitcoin claws back toward $79,000 as markets shake off crypto's biggest hack
articles.description: ZEC led the majors and oil slid on a report that Trump wants to give Iran diplomacy more time, with U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday.

articles.title: BTCPay, a bitcoin payment tool, tells users to switch off their servers after reports of drained wallets
articles.description: The open-source project says it is still investigating and hasn't given a loss figure or announced a fix. Its founder said the reports appear to involve versions older than 2.4.2.

articles.title: The crypto reader's guide to the 2026 midterm election: State of Crypto
articles.description: America is going to the polls, and the results will shape crypto legislation and regulation over the next two years. Here's what to know.

articles.title: AI agents bypassed crypto spending limits without human approval, researchers find in a new test
articles.description: The researchers say any approval an agent can reach is unreliable, and they built Countersign, an app tying approval to a physical action the agent can’t fake.

articles.title: The key races to watch for the 2026 election
articles.description: While crypto isn't a major issue in the 2026 election, the industry will be shaped by who takes office in January. Here are the main races CoinDesk is tracking.

articles.title: Crypto card startups are racking up losses just to buy your loyalty with big rewards
articles.description: Providers are betting trading, lending and staking revenue can cover rewards and turn card users into profitable customers.

articles.title: Crypto PACs made big Republican push in final weeks before November 3 election
articles.description: Even as polling and online wagers put Democrats at a high chance to claim greater power in Congress, the industry's high-profile support has gone the other direction.

articles.title: Sherrod Brown's Ohio edge threatens a rough go for crypto next year
articles.description: The industry's $63 million question revolves around whether its political adversary in Ohio rides the Trump backlash back into the Senate.

articles.title: Binance opens crypto withdrawals in phases starting with bitcoin following $6.3 billion hack
articles.description: Binance reopens customer withdrawals following a record $6.3 billion exploit. Bitcoin leads the first phase.

articles.title: FBI confirms North Korea's role in $6 billion Binance hack, asks DeFi community to block BTC, ETH, SOL addresses
articles.description: While the FBI listed hundreds of addresses in its notice, Chainalysis said the Binance attackers have already used "thousands addresses," and expects this number to continue growing.

articles.title: Bitcoin's white paper turns 18, and small businesses are still paying for the bailouts it answered
articles.description: Eighteen years after Satoshi published the Bitcoin white paper, business owners are still covering the cost of a system built on bailouts, and they can protect part of their surplus by keeping it in bitcoin, argues Onramp CEO Michael Tanguma.

articles.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
articles.description: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

articles.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
articles.description: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

articles.title: Binance says it has replaced 90% of stolen crypto after massive $6.3 billion breach
articles.description: Binance is absorbing all losses through corporate funds, futures reserves, and SAFU, keeping user balances intact.

articles.title: Institutions embrace crypto staking despite shrinking yields
articles.description: Easier access and growing familiarity are encouraging investors to stake their tokens, while falling rewards and withdrawal delays test the economics.

articles.title: Uber tests how tokenization can put idle cash to work with HSBC, Franklin Templeton
articles.description: The pilot let Uber keep funds invested in money market products while accessing cash for payments, even on weekends.

articles.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
articles.description: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.
